jobs.title: VILLA SALES, RESERVATION & OPERATIONS OFFICER
jobs.description: Location: Pecatu, Uluwatu - Bali (Preffer to candidates who currently reside within approximately 20–30 minutes of the villa location in Pecatu, Uluwatu.) Employment Type: Full Time Salary: Rp5.000.000/month + Sales Incentive/Commission About the Position: We are looking for a proactive, communicative, and hospitality-oriented Villa Sales, Reservation & Operations Officer to manage daily villa operations while supporting sales, reservations, OTA management, and guest relations. This position is suitable for someone who can work independently, is comfortable communicating with guests, and has a strong understanding of hospitality operations and online booking platforms. Key Responsibilities 1. OTA & Reservation Manage villa listings and reservations through OTA platforms such as Booking.com, Agoda, Airbnb, Expedia, etc. Monitor room availability, rates, promotions, and inventory. Respond to guest inquiries promptly and professionally. Handle booking confirmations, cancellations, modifications, and special requests. Maintain an accurate reservation calendar and prevent double bookings. Follow up with potential guests to convert inquiries into bookings. Prepare daily/weekly reservation reports. 2. Sales & Revenue Generate direct bookings through WhatsApp, Instagram, website, referrals, and other channels. Follow up leads and potential customers. Develop relationships with travel agents, tour operators, and local partners. Promote villa packages and special offers. Upsell additional services such as airport transfers, breakfast, BBQ, tours, transportation, etc. Achieve agreed monthly occupancy and revenue targets. Monitor competitor rates and market conditions. 3. Guest Relations & Concierge Communicate with guests before, during, and after their stay. Coordinate check-in and check-out arrangements. Assist guests with transportation, restaurant reservations, tours, activities, and other requests. Handle guest complaints professionally and coordinate solutions. Ensure guests receive a positive and personalized experience. Follow up on guest feedback and online reviews. 4. Villa Operations Conduct daily villa readiness and operational checks. Ensure the villa and public areas are clean, presentable, and guest-ready. Coordinate with Housekeeping, Maintenance, Garden, and Pool teams. Monitor amenities, linen, guest supplies, and operational inventory. Report maintenance issues and follow up on completion. Ensure operational standards are maintained. Assist management in implementing SOPs and improving guest experience. 5. Public Area Monitoring Monitor cleanliness and presentation of entrance, pool area, garden, terrace, parking area, and other public areas. Coordinate cleaning and maintenance requirements. Ensure all public areas are safe, clean, and ready for guests. Requirements Minimum education: SMA/SMK/Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Business, or related field. Minimum 1–2 years of experience in hotel, villa, resort, reservation, sales, or hospitality operations. Experience handling OTA platforms is preferred. Good knowledge of reservation processes and hospitality operations. Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Strong customer service and problem-solving skills. Comfortable using WhatsApp, email, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and basic Excel. Able to work independently with minimal supervision. Able to coordinate multiple operational tasks. Target-oriented and willing to work with sales targets. Well-groomed, professional, friendly, and service-oriented. Willing to work weekends, public holidays, and according to villa operational requirements. Having a valid driving license and own transportation is an advantage. Key Skills Must Have OTA management Reservation handling Guest communication Basic sales skills English communication Microsoft Office / Google Workspace Problem solving Operational coordination Preferred Booking.com / Agoda / Airbnb experience PMS experience Revenue management knowledge Travel agent/networking experience Social media and digital marketing knowledge Experience in villa operations

jobs.title: HUMAN CAPITAL MANAGER
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Human Capital Manager to lead and strengthen our people strategy while supporting business growth and operational excellence across the organization. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement Human Capital strategies aligned with business objectives and expansion plans. Lead workforce planning initiatives to ensure adequate manpower availability across business units and outlets. Oversee end-to-end Human Capital functions, including Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, Performance Management, Employee Relations, Industrial Relations, and HR Operations. Drive the implementation of performance management systems, KPI frameworks, talent development, and succession planning initiatives. Ensure payroll, employee administration, benefits, and labor compliance processes are executed accurately and efficiently. Build and strengthen organizational culture through employee engagement and culture development programs. Partner closely with operational leaders to improve workforce productivity, employee capability, and organizational effectiveness. Analyze people metrics and provide strategic recommendations to support management decision-making. Support new branch openings by ensuring manpower readiness, training readiness, and organizational setup. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Psychology, Management, Law, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in Human Resources / Human Capital. jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description: About the role Develop and lead Sensatia's marketing strategy, annual marketing plan and campaign calendar in line with company growth objectives and brand direction. Lead integrated marketing planning and execution across brand communications, retail marketing, product launches, events, partnerships and other customer-facing initiatives. Key responsibilities Develop and lead Sensatia's marketing strategy, annual marketing plan and campaign calendar in line with company growth objectives and brand direction. Lead integrated marketing planning and execution across brand communications, retail marketing, product launches, events, partnerships and other customer-facing initiatives. Develop, own and manage the Marketing budget within the overall Commercial plan, ensuring disciplined allocation of resources and measurable commercial and brand outcomes. Strengthen Sensatia's brand positioning and ensure consistent brand expression across all customer touchpoints. Translate company and commercial objectives into clear marketing priorities, campaigns and execution plans. Work closely with Digital Marketing, Creative, E-Commerce, Sales, Retail Operations and Visual Merchandising to deliver coordinated commercial initiatives. Establish clear objectives and KPIs for marketing activities, evaluate performance and continuously improve marketing effectiveness and ROI. Use customer, market, competitive and commercial insights to identify opportunities and inform marketing decisions. Lead, coach and develop the Marketing team, creating clear accountability and building stronger marketing capabilities. About you Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of relevant marketing experience, including experience leading and developing a team. Strong consumer-brand marketing experience; beauty, skincare, personal care, FMCG, lifestyle, retail or premium consumer-brand experience is preferred. Strong understanding of brand strategy, consumer marketing and commercial marketing. Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns and managing meaningful marketing budgets. Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into strong execution and measurable outcomes. Commercially minded and comfortable using data, customer insights, KPIs and ROI to evaluate marketing performance. Strong leadership, strategic thinking, communication and project-management capabilities. Professional proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Based in Bali or willing to relocate and work from Padang Galak Sales & Marketing Office.

jobs.title: Finance Accounting Tax Superintendent - Tambang / Sawit/Konstruksi
jobs.description: URAIAN TUGAS DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB : 1. Perusahaan Pertambangan Tugas FAT Superintendent di sektor tambang sangat berfokus pada efisiensi biaya operasional alat berat, perizinan Royalti/PNBP, serta pengawasan biaya di area site/site office. Finance & Cost Control Pengendalian Cost per Ton : Mengendalikan biaya operasional penambangan (BBM, perawatan unit, suku cadang alat berat, dan subcontractor/hauling ). Kas Site & Head Office: Mengelola dana operasional lapangan ( petty cash site ) serta pengajuan pencairan dana berkala ke HO. Accounting Akuntansi Tambang & Aset: Mengelola pencatatan penyusutan alat berat, akuisisi lahan, biaya eksplorasi/eksploitasi, serta rekapitulasi persediaan ( stockpile inventory ). Rekonsiliasi Produksi: Mencocokkan data pencatatan transaksi akuntansi dengan laporan ritase/overburden (OB) dan penjualan kargo dari tim operasional/geologi. Taxation & Compliance Pajak & Retribusi Daerah: Mengelola kewajiban PPh Pasal 22 impor, PPh Pasal 23 jasa tambang/alat berat, PPN, Pajak Bahan Bakar (PBBKB), serta Pajak Air Tanah/Permukaan. Kepatuhan PNBP & Royalti: Memastikan perhitungan dan pembayaran Royalti (PNBP tambang) sesuai dengan harga patokan komoditas resmi pemerintah. 2. Perusahaan Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit (Agribisnis/PKS) Fokus utama di industri sawit mencakup akuntansi biologis (kebun), pengeluaran Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), serta penanganan skema kemitraan plasma. Finance Arus Kas Musim Panen: Mengatur ketersediaan kas harian untuk pembelian Tandan Buah Segar (TBS) dari pihak ketiga/petani luar dan pengadaan pupuk skala besar. Manajemen Pembayaran Plasma: Memantau perhitungan dan pencairan dana bagi hasil untuk kebun kemitraan (Plasma/KUD). Accounting Akuntansi Aset Biologis (PSAK 69): Menghitung dan mencatat nilai wajar Tanaman Belum Menghasilkan (TBM) hingga menjadi Tanaman Menghasilkan (TM). HPP & Stok Minyak Sawit: Menghitung Biaya Pokok Produksi (HPP) Crude Palm Oil (CPO) dan Palm Kernel (PK) serta melakukan kontrol atas penyusutan stok di tangki timbun ( CPO storage tank ). Taxation Restitusi PPN: Mengelola pengajuan restitusi PPN secara rutin karena karakter usaha ekspor atau penyerahan CPO yang memicu lebih bayar. Pajak Khusus Perkebunan: Mengurus perhitungan Bea Keluar/Pungutan Ekspor CPO, PPh 22 Pembelian TBS dari Petani, serta PBB Sektor Perkebunan. 3. Perusahaan Konstruksi & Kontraktor FAT Superintendent di sektor konstruksi bertanggung jawab penuh terhadap akuntansi proyek, cash flow per proyek, serta penanganan potongan/retensi pembayaran. Finance Cash Flow Proyek: Memantau likuiditas untuk mendukung pembelian material, operasional subkontraktor, dan pembayaran upah tenaga kerja harian/borongan. Manajemen Penagihan (Termin): Menyusun dan memantau klaim penagihan ke pemilik proyek ( owner/client ) berdasarkan progres fisik. URAIAN TUGAS DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB :

1. Perusahaan Pertambangan

Tugas FAT Superintendent di sektor tambang sangat berfokus pada efisiensi biaya operasional alat berat, perizinan Royalti/PNBP, serta pengawasan biaya di area site/site office.

Finance & Cost Control

  • Pengendalian Cost per Ton: Mengendalikan biaya operasional penambangan (BBM, perawatan unit, suku cadang alat berat, dan subcontractor/hauling).

  • Kas Site & Head Office: Mengelola dana operasional lapangan (petty cash site) serta pengajuan pencairan dana berkala ke HO.

Accounting

  • Akuntansi Tambang & Aset: Mengelola pencatatan penyusutan alat berat, akuisisi lahan, biaya eksplorasi/eksploitasi, serta rekapitulasi persediaan (stockpile inventory).

  • Rekonsiliasi Produksi: Mencocokkan data pencatatan transaksi akuntansi dengan laporan ritase/overburden (OB) dan penjualan kargo dari tim operasional/geologi.

Taxation & Compliance

  • Pajak & Retribusi Daerah: Mengelola kewajiban PPh Pasal 22 impor, PPh Pasal 23 jasa tambang/alat berat, PPN, Pajak Bahan Bakar (PBBKB), serta Pajak Air Tanah/Permukaan.

  • Kepatuhan PNBP & Royalti: Memastikan perhitungan dan pembayaran Royalti (PNBP tambang) sesuai dengan harga patokan komoditas resmi pemerintah.

2. Perusahaan Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit (Agribisnis/PKS)

Fokus utama di industri sawit mencakup akuntansi biologis (kebun), pengeluaran Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), serta penanganan skema kemitraan plasma.

Finance

  • Arus Kas Musim Panen: Mengatur ketersediaan kas harian untuk pembelian Tandan Buah Segar (TBS) dari pihak ketiga/petani luar dan pengadaan pupuk skala besar.

  • Manajemen Pembayaran Plasma: Memantau perhitungan dan pencairan dana bagi hasil untuk kebun kemitraan (Plasma/KUD).

Accounting

  • Akuntansi Aset Biologis (PSAK 69): Menghitung dan mencatat nilai wajar Tanaman Belum Menghasilkan (TBM) hingga menjadi Tanaman Menghasilkan (TM).

  • HPP & Stok Minyak Sawit: Menghitung Biaya Pokok Produksi (HPP) Crude Palm Oil (CPO) dan Palm Kernel (PK) serta melakukan kontrol atas penyusutan stok di tangki timbun (CPO storage tank).

Taxation

  • Restitusi PPN: Mengelola pengajuan restitusi PPN secara rutin karena karakter usaha ekspor atau penyerahan CPO yang memicu lebih bayar.

  • Pajak Khusus Perkebunan: Mengurus perhitungan Bea Keluar/Pungutan Ekspor CPO, PPh 22 Pembelian TBS dari Petani, serta PBB Sektor Perkebunan.

Finance

  • Software Keuangan & ERP: Mahir menggunakan sistem ERP terintegrasi (seperti SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, atau Microsoft Dynamics 365) serta aplikasi perpajakan (e-Faktur, e-SPT, Coretax).

  • Keahlian Manajerial: Memiliki kepemimpinan yang kuat, analisis keuangan (financial modeling/analytical thinking), pemecahan masalah, dan kemampuan komunikasi interpersonal.

Kualifikasi Spesifik per Industri

3. Perusahaan Konstruksi & Kontraktor

  • Pengalaman Sektor: Berpengalaman di perusahaan kontraktor general, infrastruktur, atau EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction).

  • Akuntansi Kontrak: Memahami pengakuan pendapatan berdasarkan metode Percentage of Completion (PSAK 72), penanganan Work in Progress (WIP), dan retensi proyek.

jobs.description: About the role Lead Sensatia's B2B and account-based Sales function, with accountability for agreed revenue, gross margin and profitable growth targets across assigned channels. jobs.company: BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN (PT. BUMI HIJAU MOTOR)
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari seorang Sales Supervisor yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan kami di BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN (PT. BUMI HIJAU MOTOR) di Samarinda, Kalimantan Timur. Sebagai Sales Supervisor, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memimpin tim penjualan, mencapai target penjualan, dan memastikan kepuasan pelanggan yang optimal. Posisi ini membutuhkan profesional yang memiliki kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat, pemahaman mendalam tentang strategi penjualan, dan motivasi tinggi untuk mendorong pertumbuhan bisnis. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi fulltime yang berbasis di Samarinda, Kalimantan Timur, dengan peluang pengembangan karier yang menjanjikan di industri otomotif yang terus berkembang. Tanggung Jawab Memimpin, mengawasi, dan mengelola tim penjualan untuk mencapai target penjualan bulanan dan tahunan yang telah ditetapkan. Merencanakan dan mengimplementasikan strategi penjualan yang efektif untuk meningkatkan volume penjualan dan pangsa pasar. Memberikan coaching, pelatihan, dan bimbingan kepada anggota tim penjualan untuk meningkatkan keterampilan dan kinerja mereka. Memantau kinerja tim secara berkelanjutan melalui analisis data penjualan dan memberikan feedback konstruktif untuk perbaikan berkelanjutan. Mengelola hubungan dengan pelanggan kunci dan memastikan tingkat kepuasan pelanggan yang tinggi melalui layanan purna jual yang excellent. Melakukan presentasi produk dan negosiasi dengan calon pelanggan untuk menutup penjualan yang signifikan. Membuat laporan penjualan terperinci dan menganalisis trend pasar untuk memberikan insight kepada manajemen. Mengoordinasikan dengan departemen lain seperti operasional dan layanan pelanggan untuk memastikan pengalaman pelanggan yang seamless. Merekrut, menyeleksi, dan mengembangkan talenta baru untuk tim penjualan. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal SMA/SMK sederajat, lebih baik jika memiliki Diploma atau Gelar Sarjana dalam bidang Bisnis, Manajemen, Penjualan, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 3-5 tahun pengalaman di bidang penjualan dengan pengalaman khusus dalam manajemen tim atau kepemimpinan. Pengalaman yang terbukti dalam industri otomotif atau penjualan produk high-value merupakan nilai tambah yang signifikan. Kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat dengan keterampilan manajemen tim yang excellent dan mampu memotivasi tim mencapai target. Penguasaan teknik penjualan, negosiasi, dan closing yang matang serta customer relationship management. Kemampuan analisis data yang baik untuk mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan penjualan dan mengoptimalkan strategi. Keterampilan komunikasi yang luar biasa baik dalam presentasi maupun dalam membangun hubungan interpersonal. Pemahaman tentang target market dan segmentasi pelanggan serta kemampuan mengidentifikasi peluang cross-selling dan upselling. Kemauan untuk bekerja di bawah tekanan dengan deadline yang ketat sambil mempertahankan kualitas pekerjaan. Integritas tinggi, profesionalisme, dan dedikasi terhadap pencapaian target dan kepuasan pelanggan. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif dan tunjangan kinerja berdasarkan pencapaian target penjualan. Bonus insentif menarik untuk pencapaian target dan kinerja tim yang exceeds expectations. Asuransi kesehatan komprehensif untuk Anda dan keluarga dengan coverage yang luas. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional, kolaboratif, dan mendukung inovasi dalam strategi penjualan. Akses ke produk dan teknologi terkini dari BYD, salah satu produsen kendaraan listrik terdepan di dunia. Kesempatan untuk bekerja dengan brand ternama dan berbagai benefit karyawan lainnya sesuai dengan kebijakan perusahaan. Tentang Kami BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN (PT. BUMI HIJAU MOTOR) adalah distributor resmi produk BYD, salah satu produsen kendaraan listrik dan solusi energi terbarukan terkemuka di dunia. Perusahaan kami berkomitmen untuk membawa inovasi teknologi otomotif canggih dan ramah lingkungan ke pasar Indonesia, khususnya di kawasan Kalimantan. Dengan fokus pada keberlanjutan, kualitas produk, dan kepuasan pelanggan, BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN terus berkembang dan memperluas jangkauan bisnis di wilayah timur Indonesia. Kami percaya bahwa tim yang termotivasi, profesional, dan berpengalaman adalah kunci kesuksesan kami. Kami menyediakan lingkungan kerja yang mendorong kreativitas, inovasi, dan pertumbuhan profesional bagi setiap karyawan. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki passion dalam penjualan, kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat, dan tertarik untuk berkembang bersama BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN, kami sangat ingin mendengar dari Anda. Silakan lamar sekarang dengan mengirimkan CV, surat motivasi, dan referensi profesional Anda kepada tim Human Resources kami. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan jadilah bagian dari revolusi transportasi berkelanjutan di Indonesia!

jobs.title: Front Office
jobs.description: Job Description Menyambut dan melayani pelanggan dengan ramah, profesional, serta memberikan pengalaman yang positif sesuai standar pelayanan SUNSRI Jewelry. Memberikan informasi mengenai produk, layanan, promo, dan kebijakan perusahaan kepada pelanggan. Melakukan follow-up kepada pelanggan terkait pesanan, pembayaran, pengambilan barang, maupun layanan purna jual (after-sales service). Menangani pertanyaan, permintaan, serta keluhan pelanggan dengan profesional dan memberikan solusi sesuai prosedur perusahaan. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Gallery, Produksi, Inventory, dan divisi terkait untuk memastikan kebutuhan pelanggan terpenuhi dengan baik. Membantu proses administrasi operasional, termasuk pengarsipan dokumen dan penyusunan laporan harian. Memastikan area Front Office selalu bersih, rapi, nyaman, dan siap menyambut pelanggan. Menjaga kerahasiaan data pelanggan dan informasi perusahaan. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK sederajat. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Front Office, Customer Service, Receptionist, atau posisi sejenis (fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar apabila memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik). Posisi ini merupakan kesempatan menarik bagi individu yang memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, inisiatif tinggi, dan passion dalam penjualan ritel. Jabatan ini adalah posisi fulltime yang mengharuskan Anda untuk bekerja secara mobile di wilayah, mengunjungi berbagai lokasi strategis untuk memaksimalkan penjualan produk.

Tanggung Jawab

  • Mengunjungi lokasi-lokasi strategis secara berkala untuk mempromosikan dan menjual produk snack kepada pelanggan potensial.
  • Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan baik dengan pelanggan untuk meningkatkan loyalitas dan repeat order.
  • Mencapai target penjualan bulanan yang telah ditetapkan oleh manajemen.
  • Memberikan informasi produk yang akurat dan menarik kepada calon pembeli.
  • Mengelola inventori produk dan memastikan ketersediaan stok yang memadai selama kegiatan penjualan.
  • Mencatat setiap transaksi penjualan dengan akurat dan melaporkannya secara berkala kepada tim manajemen.
  • Menunjukkan antusiasme tinggi dalam mempromosikan kualitas dan keunggulan produk snack kami.
  • Memberikan feedback dari pasar kepada tim untuk mendukung pengembangan strategi penjualan yang lebih baik.

Persyaratan

  • Minimal SMA/SMK atau pendidikan setara dengan pengalaman penjualan ritel yang relevan.
  • Pengalaman 1-2 tahun sebagai Sales Motoris atau posisi penjualan lapangan yang sejenis.
  • Memiliki kendaraan roda dua atau roda empat dengan SIM yang masih berlaku.
  • Kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik dan kemampuan persuasi yang kuat.
  • Inisiatif tinggi, disiplin, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri dengan minimal supervisi.
  • Penampilan rapi dan profesional untuk merepresentasikan brand perusahaan.
  • Kemampuan dalam menangani kas dan pencatatan transaksi penjualan.
  • Bersedia bekerja dengan jadwal yang fleksibel sesuai kebutuhan operasional.
  • Pengetahuan tentang produk snack dan industri ritel dianggap nilai tambah.

Benefit

  • Gaji pokok yang kompetitif dengan sistem komisi penjualan yang menarik.
  • Bonus insentif bulanan berdasarkan pencapaian target penjualan.
  • Tunjangan transportasi dan perjalanan untuk mendukung aktivitas penjualan.
  • Asuransi kesehatan dasar untuk karyawan dan keluarga.
  • Kesempatan pengembangan karier dan pelatihan penjualan berkelanjutan.
  • Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung dan tim yang kolaboratif.
  • Cuti tahunan dan hari libur sesuai dengan ketentuan perundangan yang berlaku.

Tentang Kami
TANGGA AGENCY' adalah perusahaan di industri Ritel & Produk Konsumen yang berkomitmen untuk menyediakan produk snack berkualitas tinggi kepada pelanggan. Kami percaya bahwa setiap produk yang kami tawarkan harus memberikan kepuasan maksimal dan nilai terbaik kepada konsumen. Tim kami terdiri dari profesional yang berdedikasi dan bersemangat dalam menghadirkan pengalaman berbelanja terbaik. Dengan fokus pada inovasi, kualitas, dan kepuasan pelanggan, kami terus berkembang dan memperluas jangkauan pasar kami. Kami menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang positif dan inklusif di mana setiap anggota tim memiliki kesempatan yang sama untuk berkembang dan mencapai kesuksesan bersama.

Lamar Sekarang
Jika Anda tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim TANGGA AGENCY' dan memiliki semangat dalam penjualan, kami mengundang Anda untuk segera melamar posisi ini. jobs.title: General Manager Legal Corporate- Holding Company
jobs.description: Tugas Utama & Tanggung Jawab : Manajemen & Strategi Hukum: Merumuskan strategi hukum perusahaan, memberikan nasehat hukum ( legal advice ) kepada direksi/manajemen, serta memastikan seluruh operasional bisnis sejalan dengan regulasi pemerintah. Penyusunan & Peninjauan Kontrak ( Legal Drafting & Review ): Memimpin pembuatan, pemeriksaan, dan negosiasi semua perjanjian kerja sama, kontrak bisnis (lokal maupun internasional), serta dokumen legalitas lainnya. Kepatuhan Regulasi & Tata Kelola ( Corporate Governance ): Memastikan perusahaan mematuhi seluruh perundang-undangan ( compliance ), mengurus perizinan badan usaha, serta menerapkan prinsip Good Corporate Governance (GCG). Manajemen Sengketa & Litigasi ( Litigation & Dispute Resolution ): Menangani sengketa hukum, klaim, atau tuntutan terhadap perusahaan; serta berkoordinasi dengan pengacara/konsultan hukum eksternal jika kasus masuk ke ranah pengadilan. Corporate Action & Transaksi Strategis: Menangani aspek hukum terkait tindakan korporasi seperti akuisisi, merger, restrukturisasi perusahaan, penanaman modal, atau penerbitan saham/obligasi. Manajemen Tim & Aset Legal: Memimpin dan mengembangkan tim legal , serta mengelola dokumen dan lisensi legalitas perusahaan ( corporate secretary & legal documentation ). Kualifikasi : 1. Pendidikan & Sertifikasi Pendidikan Minimal: S1 Hukum (S.H.) dari universitas dengan reputasi baik. Gelar S2 (Magister Hukum/LL.M. atau MM/MBA) menjadi nilai tambah yang signifikan. Memiliki Lisensi / Sertifikasi Professional, menjadi nilai tambah : Lisensi Advokat aktif (PERADI atau organisasi advokat resmi lainnya) Sertifikasi Kepatuhan (Certified Legal Compliance Professional) atau Konsultan Hukum Pasar Modal, lebih disukai. 2. Pengalaman Kerja Pengalaman Minimum: Minimum 10–12 tahun pengalaman di bidang hukum bisnis (corporate legal). Pengalaman Manajerial: Minimum 3–5 tahun di posisi tingkat manajerial puncak (seperti Legal Manager, Head of Legal, atau Senior Legal Counsel). jobs.description: KESEMPATAN CV BUMINET PRAKARSA' mencari Key Account Manager yang berpengalaman dan dinamis untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan kami di Bali. Sebagai Key Account Manager, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengelola dan mengembangkan hubungan dengan klien-klien kunci perusahaan. Posisi ini memerlukan profesional yang mampu mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan, membangun kepercayaan jangka panjang dengan klien, dan memastikan kepuasan pelanggan yang optimal. Anda akan bekerja secara penuh waktu dari lokasi Bali, dengan tanggung jawab mengelola portofolio akun bernilai tinggi dan berkontribusi langsung pada pertumbuhan pendapatan perusahaan. TUGAS DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB Membangun dan menjaga hubungan jangka panjang dengan klien strategis. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri, kami telah membangun reputasi sebagai mitra bisnis yang terpercaya dan inovatif. Perusahaan kami mengutamakan integritas, profesionalisme, dan kepuasan pelanggan dalam setiap aspek operasional. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan kami terletak pada tim yang berdedikasi, berbakat, dan berbisnis dengan nilai-nilai etika yang kuat. Bali menjadi hub operasional kami yang strategis, memungkinkan kami untuk melayani klien dengan lebih baik dan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inspiratif. Kami terus berinovasi dan berkembang, menciptakan peluang karier yang bermakna bagi profesional berbakat yang ingin berkontribusi pada pertumbuhan bersama. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda adalah Key Account Manager yang berpengalaman, strategis, dan passionate dalam membangun hubungan klien yang kuat, kami mengundang Anda untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portfolio pencapaian penjualan Anda kepada kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih baik dan membahas bagaimana Anda dapat berkontribusi pada kesuksesan CV BUMINET PRAKARSA'.

Rika Spa is growing and opening opportunities for experienced Spa Therapists who are friendly, disciplined, and have the spirit to develop with our team. Key responsibilities

  • Perform various types of body massage according to Rika Spa standards

  • Perform waxing treatment

  • Perform eyelash extensions

  • Participate in training and skills development provided

  • Experience as a Spa Therapist / Beauty Therapist

  • Proficiency in body massage

  • Ability in facial, waxing, manicure & pedicure

  • Eyelash extensions ability is an added value

  • Honest, disciplined, responsible, and hardworking

  • Friendly with good attitude

  • Able to work individually and in a team

  • Basic English language ability to communicate with guests

  • Willing to learn and improve skills

  • Willing to participate in training required by Rika Spa

  • Total income up to Rp7,000,000 per month, consisting of: base salary, meal allowance, monthly commission, performance-based incentives & bonuses

  • THR according to regulations

  • Training & skills development

  • Opportunity to develop and advance career

  • Professional, positive, and supportive work environment

jobs.description: About the role Pisang Madu Pasti (PMP) is looking for a detail-oriented, disciplined, and quality-focused Staff Quality Control to ensure that product quality, food safety, cleanliness, and operational standards are consistently maintained across our outlets. You will conduct monitoring and inspection regularly to ensure all outlets implement SOP, product quality standards, cleanliness, and food safety according to PMP standards. Key responsibilities Conduct quality control and inspection routinely at outlets Ensure product quality meets established standards by checking taste, texture, appearance, size, and presentation Verify food safety, hygiene, and sanitation implementation at outlets Check cleanliness of production areas, equipment, storage, and service areas Ensure raw material storage complies with FIFO/FEFO standards and applicable regulations Check condition, quality, and expiration dates of raw materials Ensure employees follow production, handling, storage, and cleanliness SOPs Record inspection findings and prepare QC reports Provide corrective action recommendations for outlet findings and follow up until standards are met Coordinate with Operation, Production, and Outlet teams regarding quality improvements About you Minimum D3/S1 degree in Food Technology, Culinary Arts, Nutrition, Biology, Chemistry, or related field Fresh graduates welcome; experience as QC in F&B is a plus Understanding of Quality Control basics, Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation Understanding of FIFO/FEFO principles, raw material storage, and food handling Detail-oriented, disciplined, assertive, with strong observation skills Able to identify problems and provide improvement recommendations Good communication and coordination abilities Able to prepare inspection reports neatly Able to work independently and in a team Willing to conduct visits/inspections to outlets as needed; personal vehicle and driving license are a plus Benefits Opportunity to grow with an expanding F&B brand Direct experience in managing quality control for F&B outlets Exposure to various aspects of food safety, product quality, and operational standards Opportunity to participate in quality improvement programs Learning & development with an experienced team Collaborative and dynamic work environment

Pisang Madu Pasti (PMP) is looking for a detail-oriented, disciplined, and quality-focused Staff Quality Control to ensure that product quality, food safety, cleanliness, and operational standards are consistently maintained across our outlets. You will conduct monitoring and inspection regularly to ensure all outlets implement SOP, product quality standards, cleanliness, and food safety according to PMP standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Conduct quality control and inspection routinely at outlets

  • Ensure product quality meets established standards by checking taste, texture, appearance, size, and presentation

  • Verify food safety, hygiene, and sanitation implementation at outlets

  • Check cleanliness of production areas, equipment, storage, and service areas

  • Ensure raw material storage complies with FIFO/FEFO standards and applicable regulations

  • Check condition, quality, and expiration dates of raw materials

  • Ensure employees follow production, handling, storage, and cleanliness SOPs

  • Record inspection findings and prepare QC reports

  • Provide corrective action recommendations for outlet findings and follow up until standards are met

  • Coordinate with Operation, Production, and Outlet teams regarding quality improvements

About you

  • Minimum D3/S1 degree in Food Technology, Culinary Arts, Nutrition, Biology, Chemistry, or related field

  • Fresh graduates welcome; experience as QC in F&B is a plus

  • Understanding of Quality Control basics, Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

  • Understanding of FIFO/FEFO principles, raw material storage, and food handling

  • Detail-oriented, disciplined, assertive, with strong observation skills

  • Able to identify problems and provide improvement recommendations

  • Good communication and coordination abilities

  • Able to prepare inspection reports neatly

  • Able to work independently and in a team

  • Willing to conduct visits/inspections to outlets as needed; personal vehicle and driving license are a plus

Benefits

  • Opportunity to grow with an expanding F&B brand

  • Direct experience in managing quality control for F&B outlets

  • Exposure to various aspects of food safety, product quality, and operational standards

  • Opportunity to participate in quality improvement programs

  • Learning & development with an experienced team

  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Business Platform
jobs.description: Get to Know the Team We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Business Platform team in Jakarta, Indonesia. The Business Platform powers the backend capabilities that enable businesses and enterprises to onboard, operate, grow, and serve consumers at scale across Southeast Asia. Get to Know the Role In this role, you will design, build, and evolve backend platform services that manage business profiles, store metadata, business configuration, and related operational workflows. You'll work on systems that sit close to the source of truth for business data and workflows—systems that directly influence how businesses set up their operations, how internal teams operate reliably, and how downstream products consume trusted business information. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong ownership, system design thinking, and a commitment to building platforms that simplify complexity rather than spread it around. This is an onsite role based in Jakarta. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Lead the architectural design of microservices, high-throughput APIs, and data storage solutions built to handle scale and high availability. Diagnose high-stakes performance bottlenecks, refactor core infrastructure, and ensure low latency across distributed systems. Own end-to-end delivery of mission-critical systems—from writing technical design documents (TDDs) and scoping projects to deploying and maintaining production features. Drive code quality across the team through high-bar code reviews, system reliability standards, and technical mentorship of mid/junior engineers. Oversee cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), automated CI/CD pipelines, security protocols, and robust incident management/observability to guarantee strict SLAs.

jobs.title: Admin E-Commerce
jobs.description: Ringkasan Deskripsi Pekerjaan Mengelola dan memperbarui listing produk di seluruh marketplace. Memastikan informasi produk, harga, stok, foto, deskripsi selalu akurat dan terboru. Mengelola campaign, voucher, flash sale, bundling, serta promosi marketplace. Mengoptimalkan performa produk melalui fitur marketplace dan aktivitas promosi Memantou stok, pesanan, pembatalan, retur, dan pengiriman agar berjalan dengan baik, Melayani pertanyaan pelanggan melalui chat marketplace maupun website dengan cepat dan profesional Menangani keluhan pelanggan serta memberikan solusi yang tepat. Melakukan follow up terhadap pesanan, pembayaran, dan proses pengiriman. Memantau performa toko, traffic, conversion rate, serto elektivitas promosi. Menyusun laporan penjualan harion, mingguan, dan bulanan beserta analisis dan rekomendasi peningkatan penjualan Berkoordinasi dengan tim Marketing, Gudang, Packing, dan Desain berjalan lancar Memberikan ide dan rekomendasi strategi untuk meningkatkan penjualan dan performa toko online. TARGET KPI Mencapai target penjualan (omzet) marketplace yang telah ditetapkan perusahaan. Menjaga Chat Response Rate sesuai standar marketplace. Menjaga tingkat pembatalan (Cancellation Rate) dan retur pesanan tetap rendah sesuai target perusahaan. Memastikan seluruh campaign dan promosi berjalan tepat waktu. Memastikan seluruh listing produk selalu lengkap, akurat, dan terbarul Menyampaikan laporan penjualan dan performa marketplace secara tepat waktu. Berkontribusi dalam meningkatkan traffic, conversion rate, dan penjualan toko. Syarat Pekerjaan Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK, diutamakan jurusan Administrasi, Pemasaran, Bisnis, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Admin E-Commerce atau Marketplace minimal 1 tahun. Menguasai platform marketplace seperti Shopee, TikTok Shop, Tokopedia, Lazada, dan platform lainnya. Memahami alur operasional marketplace, mulai dari upload produk, pengelolaan pesanan, promosi, hingga layanan pelanggan. Memahami fitur promosi, campaign, voucher, dan iklan marketplace. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel dengan baik. Memiliki kemampuan analisis data penjualan dan penyusunan laporan. Terbiasa bekerja berdasarkan target dan KPI. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, negosiasi, dan problem solving yang baik. Teliti, disiplin, jujur, bertanggung jawab, serta memiliki inisiatif tinggi. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan dan memiliki manajemen waktu yang baik. Bersedia bekerja 6 hari kerja dalam seminggu. Bersedia ditempatkan di Jakarta Barat Kirim Lamaran Lowongan Terkait

jobs.title: Digital Marketing - Graphic Designer & Video Editor
jobs.description: Ringkasan Deskripsi Pekerjaan Digital Marketing Merencanakan dan menjalankan strategi Digital & Social Media Marketing. Membuat ide dan konsep konten untuk Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, dan platform digital lainnya. Mengelola media sosial dan membuat copywriting/caption yang menarik. Melakukan riset tren, kompetitor, dan target audience. Menjalankan dan mengoptimalkan campaign/Meta Ads. Menganalisis performa konten dan campaign serta membuat report & insight. Membantu meningkatkan awareness, engagement, leads, dan conversion. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Designer, Video Editor, dan Content Creator. Graphic Designer & Video Editor Membuat desain grafis untuk kebutuhan Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, website, dan media digital lainnya. Membuat desain konten promosi, branding, iklan, dan kebutuhan visual perusahaan. Melakukan editing video untuk Reels, TikTok, Shorts, dan konten promosi. Mengembangkan konsep visual yang kreatif dan sesuai dengan identitas brand. Membuat desain berdasarkan brief dan kebutuhan campaign. Melakukan revisi desain/video sesuai feedback. Mengikuti tren desain, video editing, dan konten media sosial. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Digital Marketing dan Content Creator. Memastikan hasil desain dan video memiliki kualitas visual yang baik dan konsisten. Syarat Pekerjaan Digital Marketing Maksimal usia 30 tahun. Minimal S1, semua jurusan. Pengalaman Digital Marketing, Ads, SEO, atau Social Media Management. Memahami dasar Digital & Social Media Marketing. Familiar dengan Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, dan Meta Business Suite. Memiliki kemampuan copywriting dan komunikasi yang baik. Kreatif, mengikuti tren, dan mampu menghasilkan ide konten. Memahami dasar Meta Ads dan analisis performa. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Disiplin, komunikatif, bertanggung jawab, dan mau belajar. Subjek Email: DMADS Nama Graphic Designer & Video Editor Maksimal usia 30 tahun. S-1 (Semua Jurusan) Memahami dasar-dasar desain grafis dan editing video. Menguasai software seperti Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, atau software sejenis. Memiliki kemampuan membuat desain yang menarik dan komunikatif. Memahami dasar layout, typography, warna, dan visual branding. Kreatif, memiliki sense of design yang baik, dan mengikuti tren visual. Mampu melakukan editing video untuk konten media sosial. Memiliki portfolio desain/video menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun bersama tim. jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs and Permitting Manager
jobs.description: About the job Our data centers support the digital services, businesses and ideas driving communities forward. As TERA grows in Indonesia, timely and disciplined regulatory execution is essential to keeping our projects on schedule, maintaining operational readiness and supporting responsible growth. Reporting to the Head of Public Policy and Government Affairs, the Regulatory Affairs and Permitting Manager will own the end to end execution of licenses, permits, registrations, regulatory approvals, amendments and renewals across development, construction, commissioning and operations. This is an operational delivery role. Broader stakeholder engagement and strategic resources policy are led by separate members of the team. Responsibilities Lead Regulatory Affairs and Permitting • Develop and maintain a complete regulatory and permitting roadmap for each data center campus, covering development, construction, commissioning, operations and renewal requirements. • Manage applications, amendments, renewals and maintenance of all required licenses, permits, registrations and regulatory approvals. • Identify applicable requirements under Indonesian business licensing and sector regulations, including requirements administered through OSS and relevant national and regional authorities. • Communicate directly with regulatory and licensing offices to clarify requirements, submit applications, respond to questions, follow up on processing and resolve application specific issues. Protect Project Delivery • Translate regulatory requirements into clear actions, document lists, accountable owners, dependencies and target completion dates for internal project teams. • Integrate permit and approval milestones into project schedules and identify regulatory risks that could affect construction, energization, commissioning or operations. • Maintain an accurate permit tracker and document repository, including application status, validity periods, renewal deadlines, dependencies, responsible owners and evidence of approval. • Escalate stalled, high risk or schedule critical approvals with a clear assessment of the issue, project impact, recommended action and required support. Coordinate Regulatory Execution • Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, Project Management, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Environment Health and Safety, Finance and external consultants to ensure submissions are complete, accurate and timely. • Monitor regulatory changes that directly affect licensing, permitting and data center operations, and communicate practical implications to relevant internal teams. • Coordinate with Stakeholder Relations when senior government engagement or institutional escalation is required, and with Strategic Resources Policy on matters involving electricity, water, telecommunications, land and other critical resources, while retaining ownership of permit execution. • Conduct all regulatory interactions and submissions in accordance with company ethics, anti bribery, record keeping and approval requirements. Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Public Policy, Engineering or another relevant field. • At least 5 years of relevant experience in regulatory affairs, licensing, permitting, project approvals or operational compliance in Indonesia. • Hands on experience independently managing license or permit applications with government authorities and licensing offices. • Good working knowledge of Indonesian business licensing processes, including OSS, and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical project actions. • Strong project management, documentation, coordination, follow up and problem solving skills. • Ability to work effectively with technical teams and understand engineering or construction documents sufficiently to manage regulatory submissions. • Professional communication skills and the ability to work effectively with regulatory authorities, consultants and internal stakeholders. • Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, with willingness to travel regularly to government offices, project sites and data center campuses. Preferred Qualifications • Experience in data centers, telecommunications, power, infrastructure, construction, industrial estates, manufacturing, energy or another regulated sector. • Experience managing regulatory requirements across multiple projects or campuses with competing deadlines and approval dependencies. • The ability to operate effectively in fast paced, ambiguous and resource constrained environments. • Mandarin proficiency is helpful but not required.

About the job

Our data centers support the digital services, businesses and ideas driving communities forward. As TERA grows in Indonesia, timely and disciplined regulatory execution is essential to keeping our projects on schedule, maintaining operational readiness and supporting responsible growth.

Reporting to the Head of Public Policy and Government Affairs, the Regulatory Affairs and Permitting Manager will own the end to end execution of licenses, permits, registrations, regulatory approvals, amendments and renewals across development, construction, commissioning and operations. This is an operational delivery role. Broader stakeholder engagement and strategic resources policy are led by separate members of the team.

Responsibilities

Lead Regulatory Affairs and Permitting

• Develop and maintain a complete regulatory and permitting roadmap for each data center campus, covering development, construction, commissioning, operations and renewal requirements.

• Manage applications, amendments, renewals and maintenance of all required licenses, permits, registrations and regulatory approvals.

• Identify applicable requirements under Indonesian business licensing and sector regulations, including requirements administered through OSS and relevant national and regional authorities.

• Communicate directly with regulatory and licensing offices to clarify requirements, submit applications, respond to questions, follow up on processing and resolve application specific issues.


Protect Project Delivery

• Translate regulatory requirements into clear actions, document lists, accountable owners, dependencies and target completion dates for internal project teams.

• Integrate permit and approval milestones into project schedules and identify regulatory risks that could affect construction, energization, commissioning or operations.

• Maintain an accurate permit tracker and document repository, including application status, validity periods, renewal deadlines, dependencies, responsible owners and evidence of approval.

• Escalate stalled, high risk or schedule critical approvals with a clear assessment of the issue, project impact, recommended action and required support.


Coordinate Regulatory Execution

• Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, Project Management, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Environment Health and Safety, Finance and external consultants to ensure submissions are complete, accurate and timely.

• Monitor regulatory changes that directly affect licensing, permitting and data center operations, and communicate practical implications to relevant internal teams.

• Coordinate with Stakeholder Relations when senior government engagement or institutional escalation is required, and with Strategic Resources Policy on matters involving electricity, water, telecommunications, land and other critical resources, while retaining ownership of permit execution.

• Conduct all regulatory interactions and submissions in accordance with company ethics, anti bribery, record keeping and approval requirements.


Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Public Policy, Engineering or another relevant field.

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in regulatory affairs, licensing, permitting, project approvals or operational compliance in Indonesia.

• Hands on experience independently managing license or permit applications with government authorities and licensing offices.

• Good working knowledge of Indonesian business licensing processes, including OSS, and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical project actions.

• Strong project management, documentation, coordination, follow up and problem solving skills.

• Ability to work effectively with technical teams and understand engineering or construction documents sufficiently to manage regulatory submissions.

• Professional communication skills and the ability to work effectively with regulatory authorities, consultants and internal stakeholders.

• Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, with willingness to travel regularly to government offices, project sites and data center campuses.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in data centers, telecommunications, power, infrastructure, construction, industrial estates, manufacturing, energy or another regulated sector.

• Experience managing regulatory requirements across multiple projects or campuses with competing deadlines and approval dependencies.

• The ability to operate effectively in fast paced, ambiguous and resource constrained environments.

• Mandarin proficiency is helpful but not required.

jobs.title: Motion Graphic Design
jobs.description: Company Description Skyshi Digital Indonesia is a leading software engineering company providing contract-based software engineering services. Our team of experienced professionals works with our clients to develop and execute successful technology strategies. jobs.title: Finance Staff
jobs.description: FINANCE STAFF Job Responsibilities Assist the Finance Head in daily finance and administrative activities. Handle and monitor Accounts Payable (AP) transactions, including invoices, payment requests, and supporting documents. Handle and monitor Accounts Receivable (AR) transactions, including tenant billing and payment collections. Monitor and follow up on tenant payments , ensuring payments are received according to the agreed terms. Maintain accurate records of tenant receivables, payment status, outstanding balances, and related documents. Check the completeness and accuracy of financial documents before processing. Maintain and monitor finance-related contracts, agreements, payment terms, and important deadlines. Review transactions and documents to ensure compliance with company procedures and internal controls. Identify and promptly report discrepancies, irregularities, or unusual transactions to the Finance Head or Management. Coordinate with Accounting, Finance, Procurement, tenants, and other relevant parties regarding invoices, payments, contracts, and financial documentation. Coordinate with factory personnel when required for document collection, verification, and follow-up. Assist with reconciliations, financial reporting, documentation, and other finance-related tasks as assigned. Occasionally visit the company’s factory or other company locations for finance-related coordination or verification. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Good understanding of basic accounting and finance principles. Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills. Good communication and coordination skills. Responsible, trustworthy, and proactive in following up on tasks and outstanding payments. Able to identify discrepancies and appropriately escalate issues to the Finance Head or Management. Good command of English and/or Mandarin is an asset . Able to work independently and collaboratively with different departments and external parties. Willing to occasionally travel to the company’s factory or other company locations when required. Recruitment Process Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend an offline HR Test and Interview at our Jakarta office .

This is an active...", "content2": "Villa Operations Supervisor

Location: Bingin / Uluwatu, Bali
Position: Full-time

We are looking for a hands-on Villa Operations Supervisor to manage the daily operations of 7 luxury private villas in Bingin.

This is an active onsite role. You will supervise the housekeeping team, communicate with guests and make sure every villa is clean, well maintained and guest-ready.

Main Responsibilities

  • Manage the daily operations of 7 villas

  • Coordinate and supervise the housekeeping team + poolattendent and daily schedule

  • Personally check villa quality before every guest arrival

  • Monitor and respond to Airbnb / Guesty messages and guest requests

  • Coordinate check-ins, check-outs and special guest requests

  • Assist guests and make sure problems and requests are fully resolved

  • Identify maintenance issues and coordinate technicians/handymen

  • Check pool, garden, linen, amenities and villa supplies

  • Make sure Bali Bliss Villa SOPs and quality standards are followed

  • Provide Management with a short daily operational update

We Are Looking For Someone Who

  • Has experience in luxury villa, 5*hotel or hospitality operations

  • Has experience supervising housekeeping or operational staff

  • Speaks good English and Bahasa Indonesia

  • Is comfortable communicating with international guests

  • Is comfortable using WhatsApp and systems such as Airbnb / Guesty

  • Is organised, detail-oriented and has high hospitality standards

  • Takes initiative, follows up and gets things done

  • Is reliable, responsible and professional

  • Preferably lives in or close to Bingin / Uluwatu, must live in Bali already

  • Is available to work weekends/public holidays according to the schedule

What You Can Expect

  • Good basic salary

  • Full-time employment contract

  • BPJS

  • Meal allowance

  • THR

  • Full upselling bonus

  • Share in guest tips

  • 12 days annual leave

  • Training and support

  • A professional and friendly team to work with

Most Important

We are looking for someone who takes ownership.

When there is a problem, we expect you to take action, follow up and make sure it is solved.

Reporting a problem is not enough — we are looking for someone who gets things done.

Perform other cybersecurity, network security, and infrastructure-related tasks as required.

jobs.title: SALES ASURARANSI BANCASSURANCE - AREA MAKASSAR
jobs.description: Manulife Financial Corporation adalah penyedia jasa keuangan internasional terkemuka yang berdiri sejak 1887. jobs.title: Freelance Agency Partnership Executive
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Mencari dan mengidentifikasi agency yang berpotensi menjadi mitra Rubica. Melakukan outreach melalui LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, dan saluran komunikasi lainnya. Membangun dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan agency partner. Menjadwalkan dan mengikuti pertemuan dengan calon partner. Memperkenalkan layanan dan peluang kerja sama yang ditawarkan oleh Rubica. Melakukan tindak lanjut terhadap calon partner secara berkala. Mengelola dan memperbarui data prospek serta pipeline kerja sama. Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal untuk mengubah peluang menjadi proyek. Mencapai target bulanan yang telah ditetapkan. Kualifikasi Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang sales, business development, partnership, atau account management. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Memiliki kemampuan membangun relasi dan bernegosiasi. Mampu melakukan riset untuk mengidentifikasi calon partner yang potensial. Memiliki kemampuan manajemen waktu dan organisasi yang baik. Terbiasa menggunakan LinkedIn, email, Google Sheets, atau CRM. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri dan berorientasi pada target. Memiliki pengalaman bekerja sama dengan agency atau perusahaan B2B menjadi nilai tambah. Kompensasi Gaji pokok Rp1.000.000 - 1.500.000 per bulan. Komisi sebesar 15% dari net revenue untuk setiap proyek yang berhasil diperoleh melalui kerja sama dengan agency partner.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Project Manager (PM) to join our team onsite in Jakarta. In this role, you will lead end-to-end IT project delivery, oversee cross-functional execution, and ensure projects within the insurance domain are completed on schedule and within scope. JOB DESCRIPTIONS : Lead and manage end-to-end software development projects within the insurance domain from initiation to delivery. Plan, track, and manage project scope, schedules, resource allocation, and deliverables using tools like Jira. Facilitate project meetings, daily standups, sprint planning, and status reviews with internal and external stakeholders. Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, delivering clear progress updates and executive reports. Ensure all deliverables meet client expectations, technical requirements, and quality standards. Manage change requests, scope adjustments, and timeline impacts throughout the project lifecycle. Drive team alignment, accountability, and productivity to ensure smooth project delivery. JOB REQUIREMENTS : Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Management, or a related field. Minimum 2-3 years experience as an IT Project Manager or Project Lead handling software development initiatives. Hands-on project experience in the insurance or financial services industry is required. Strong proficiency in project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Trello, or similar platforms. Solid understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC)

jobs.title: Senior Golang Developer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Golang Developer to join our team in a hybrid setup based in Yogyakarta. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs while ensuring high performance, security, and seamless database integration. This opportunity is ideal for experienced developers with 4–5+ years of hands-on expertise who are detail-oriented, strong problem solvers, and ready to build robust backend solutions in a collaborative project environment. JOB DESCRIPTIONS : Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Golang. Build scalable and reliable RESTful APIs and backend services. Develop and integrate services with databases and third-party systems. Ensure application performance, reliability, security, and scalability. Collaborate with Frontend/Mobile Developers, Product, and QA teams. Perform code reviews, debugging, testing, and performance optimization. Identify and resolve technical issues across development and production environments. Maintain clean, maintainable code and technical documentation. Participate in technical discussions, sprint activities, and weekly offline meetings. Contribute to backend architecture and continuous improvement initiatives. JOB REQUIREMENTS : Minimum 4–5 years of experience as a Golang or Backend Developer. Strong proficiency in Golang, RESTful API design, and microservices architecture. Solid understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases and database optimization. Proficient with Git, unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning. Experience with Docker, CI/CD, or cloud platforms is a plus. Good understanding of software architecture, scalability, and security best practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Intermediate English proficiency (written and verbal) for team collaboration. Willing to work in a hybrid setup in Yogyakarta with weekly offline meetings.

jobs.title: LEGAL PERMIT & GOVERNMENT SPECIALIST
jobs.description: RESPONSIBILITIES: Assist in the preparation and submission of permitting documents related to Operational Store Familiar with coordination with DPMPTSP, Bapenda, Satpol PP, Dinas Lingkungan Hidup, Dinas Kesehatan, and other relevant government authorities. Experience managing permits and compliance for multiple restaurants outlets across different cities/regions is highly preferred. Collect and verify required information and documentation to meet licensing and permitting requirements. Ensure the accuracy and completeness of the company’s permitting archives and databases. Assist in drafting reports and presentations regarding legal compliance and permitting status. Manage and process local tax compliance for outlet signage, billboards, and outdoor advertisements (Pajak Reklame), including permit renewals and coordination with regional tax offices (Bapenda). Proficient in operating Indonesia’s OSS-RBA system and preparing/submitting the Investment Activity Report (LKPM). Good understanding of NIB, KBLI, Sertifikat Standar, PB-UMKU, and other business licensing requirements relevant to restaurant operations. Handle other local utility and environmental taxes/levies, ensuring all outlet assessments are legally compliant and processed on schedule. Strong ability to monitor permit validity, renewal deadlines, regulatory changes and compliance status. To record and update legal documentation (Permit & Goverment Relation) properly To ensure proper administration work in legal department REQUIREMENTS: Minimal Bachelor of Law from reputable university At least 2 years working experience in a permitting or Government Relations in house legal and familiar with FnB or Retail Business Strong understanding of property law, and basic environmental law Flexible to travel regularly across outlet locations to manage on-site permit installations, verify signage tax placements, and coordinate directly with local authorities Hands-on and pro-active, able to work both independently and as a team

jobs.title: Senior Kotlin Developer
jobs.description: We are hiring a Senior Kotlin Developer for a hybrid opportunity in Yogyakarta to design, build, and maintain high-quality mobile applications. In this role, you will drive the development and scaling of high-performance mobile applications while collaborating with cross-functional product teams in an English-speaking environment to deliver robust, high-quality user experiences. Ideal candidates possess 4–5+ years of experience in mobile applications development using Kotlin, strong proficiency in Android SDK and clean architecture. JOB DESCRIPTIONS : Develop and maintain high-quality mobile applications using Kotlin. Design and implement scalable, reliable, and maintainable application features. Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services into mobile applications. Collaborate with Product, UI/UX, Backend, and QA teams throughout the development lifecycle. Perform code reviews, debugging, testing, and performance optimization. Identify and resolve technical issues to ensure application stability. Maintain clean code, technical documentation, and development standards. Participate in technical discussions and weekly offline meetings. Contribute to continuous improvement of application architecture and development processes. JOB REQUIREMENTS : Minimum 4–5 years of experience in Kotlin and Android development. Solid understanding of Android SDK, Jetpack, Clean Architecture, and design patterns. Experience integrating RESTful APIs and third-party services. Proficient with Git, testing, debugging, and performance optimization. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Intermediate English proficiency (written and verbal) for working in an English-speaking team. Willing to work in a hybrid setup in Yogyakarta with weekly offline meetings.

jobs.title: Staff Asset Management
jobs.description: Staff Asset Management Thursina IIBS membuka kesempatan bagi kandidat yang teliti, sistematis, dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi untuk bergabung sebagai Staff Asset Management . Ringkasan Pekerjaan Mengelola administrasi, pencatatan, inventarisasi, dan monitoring aset lembaga untuk memastikan seluruh aset terdokumentasi, terkontrol, terawat, dan digunakan secara optimal. Tanggung Jawab Melakukan pencatatan dan pembaruan data aset secara akurat. Melaksanakan inventarisasi dan pengecekan aset secara berkala. Memastikan aset memiliki identitas, kode, dan dokumentasi yang sesuai. Melakukan monitoring kondisi, lokasi, dan penggunaan aset. Mengelola proses serah terima, pemindahan, peminjaman, dan pengembalian aset. Membuat laporan dan dokumentasi terkait aset. Berkoordinasi dengan unit terkait dalam pemeliharaan dan pengelolaan aset. Menindaklanjuti aset rusak, hilang, atau tidak sesuai dengan data inventaris. Mendukung proses stock opname dan audit aset lembaga. Kualifikasi Minimal D3/S1 , diutamakan Manajemen, Administrasi, Akuntansi, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman di bidang asset management, inventory, warehouse, atau administrasi. Teliti, rapi, sistematis, dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets dengan baik. Memiliki kemampuan pengolahan dan analisis data sederhana. Mampu melakukan pencatatan dan dokumentasi secara akurat. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik. Bertanggung jawab, disiplin, dan memiliki integritas tinggi. Bersedia bekerja secara aktif di lingkungan boarding school.

jobs.title: Quality Control Inspector
jobs.description: Job Summary As QC Inspector, you are the eyes and hands of our buyer's quality function on the factory floor, permanently embedded at a production facility. You will perform final random inspections on every active production style, ensuring garments meet our buyer's standards before they leave the factory, while reviewing in-line QC reports for early risk visibility. Working closely with factory inspectors and technicians, you will build trusted relationships that support continuous quality improvement over time. Your inspection data and reporting feed directly into factory scorecards and improvement plans, giving you direct, measurable impact on production quality across the region, with the opportunity to grow into Phase 2 factory capability development as the program expands. What You Will Do • Perform final random inspections (Stage 5) on finished goods in line with AQL sampling plans and our buyer's inspection criteria, evaluating garments against approved PP samples, tech packs, and workmanship standards. • Classify and document defects (critical, major, minor) accurately with photographic evidence, and contribute to Stage 7 data collection to feed factory scorecards. • Review factory in-line QC reports (Stage 4) for early risk identification, and compare AQL results against the factory's own findings to track performance over time. • Communicate inspection results to factory management, follow up on corrective actions, flag systemic quality or production risks to the QC Manager, and submit regular inspection reports. • Support factory improvement plans, such as reducing rework rates through in-line technical assistance, and contribute to Phase 2 factory capability development. • Assist with bulk fabric inspections, reporting issues such as colour shading, and build strong, trusted working relationships with factory production and QC teams. Who You Are • 2+ years of experience in garment quality inspection, ideally within menswear, tailoring, or shirts. • Solid understanding of garment construction, common defect types, and AQL inspection standards, with the ability to read and interpret tech packs and garment specifications. • Good written and spoken English for reporting to the regional QC Manager, plus local language proficiency relevant to the factory location. • Self-motivated, reliable, and able to work independently with minimal supervision. • A sharp, consistent eye for garment quality and workmanship; objective and fair in defect assessment, independent from factory pressure; clear and accurate in documentation; and disciplined and accountable while building effective relationships with factory staff. What You Will Get • Autonomy: We empower you to take ownership, make meaningful decisions, and drive impact without layers of sign-off. • Growth: We see your potential as a key asset, you'll have abundant opportunities to learn, grow, and excel in a supportive environment that encourages development at every step. • Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization. • Style: Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully crafted and high-quality products.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Facilities & General Services
jobs.description: Assistant Manager Facilities & General Services Thursina IIBS membuka kesempatan bagi profesional berpengalaman untuk bergabung sebagai Assistant Manager Facilities & General Services . Ringkasan Pekerjaan Bertanggung jawab membantu mengelola operasional fasilitas dan general services secara efektif untuk memastikan seluruh area, fasilitas, dan layanan pendukung berjalan dengan baik, aman, nyaman, dan sesuai standar pelayanan. Tanggung Jawab Mengawasi operasional facility management dan general services . Mengelola dan mengoordinasikan fungsi housekeeping, maintenance, security, laundry, dan layanan umum . Memastikan kebersihan, kenyamanan, keamanan, dan kesiapan fasilitas. Mengawasi kinerja tim, vendor, dan pihak ketiga yang terkait dengan layanan fasilitas. Melakukan monitoring terhadap kondisi fasilitas dan menindaklanjuti kebutuhan perbaikan. Mengidentifikasi permasalahan operasional serta memastikan penyelesaiannya secara efektif. Mendukung pengembangan standar dan peningkatan kualitas layanan fasilitas. Kualifikasi Minimal S1, diutamakan dari bidang Hospitality, Manajemen, Perhotelan. Memiliki pengalaman kerja yang kuat di industri perhotelan, khususnya dalam pengelolaan operasional hotel. Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman sebagai General Manager, Hotel Manager, Operations Manager, atau posisi manajerial setara di hotel. Memahami pengelolaan housekeeping, engineering/maintenance, security, laundry, dan general services. Memiliki pengalaman memimpin tim dan mengelola operasional dengan jumlah pengguna/aktivitas yang tinggi. Memiliki kemampuan leadership, problem solving, koordinasi, dan vendor management yang baik. Memiliki orientasi yang kuat terhadap service quality, safety, cleanliness, efficiency, dan customer satisfaction. Mampu bekerja secara sistematis, responsif, dan memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Bersedia bekerja dalam lingkungan boarding school dengan aktivitas operasional yang dinamis. Mengapa Bergabung dengan Thursina? Bergabunglah bersama Thursina IIBS untuk menjadi bagian dari lingkungan pendidikan yang berkomitmen membangun excellent people, excellent service, dan excellent environment .

jobs.title: Junior Event Manager
jobs.description: About the role We are looking for a Junior Event Manager to join our growing team and support the planning and execution of exciting corporate events, MICE programs, and other special projects. Key responsibilities Assist the Event Manager in planning, coordinating, and executing events from preparation to post-event evaluation Coordinate with clients, vendors, venues, suppliers, and internal teams Prepare event timelines, rundown, checklists, presentations, and other event-related documents Support venue inspections, site visits, and event rehearsals Monitor event setup, operations, and dismantling to ensure everything runs smoothly Assist in managing event budgets, quotations, purchase orders, and vendor coordination Handle on-site event coordination and troubleshoot operational issues when required Ensure all event details and client requirements are communicated clearly to the relevant teams Prepare post-event reports and documentation About you Minimum Bachelor's Degree in Event Management, Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, or a related field Minimum 1–2 years of experience in event management, hospitality, MICE, or a related industry. Fresh graduates with strong internship or event experience are also welcome to apply Strong organizational and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail Able to manage multiple tasks and work under tight deadlines Good communication and interpersonal skills Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia, both written and spoken Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint Able and willing to work flexible hours, including weekends or public holidays when required for events A proactive, responsible, adaptable, and solution-oriented individual Experience in handling corporate events, MICE, incentive groups, or international clients will be an advantage Benefits Opportunity to work on exciting corporate and international events Dynamic and collaborative working environment Career development and growth opportunities within the company Exposure to various aspects of event management, including MICE, production, logistics, and client management

About the role

We are looking for a Junior Event Manager to join our growing team and support the planning and execution of exciting corporate events, MICE programs, and other special projects.

Key responsibilities

  • Assist the Event Manager in planning, coordinating, and executing events from preparation to post-event evaluation

  • Coordinate with clients, vendors, venues, suppliers, and internal teams

  • Experience in handling corporate events, MICE, incentive groups, or international clients will be an advantage

Benefits

  • Opportunity to work on exciting corporate and international events

  • Dynamic and collaborative working environment

  • Career development and growth opportunities within the company

Fleksibilitas untuk bekerja dengan shift, termasuk pagi, sore, malam, dan akhir pekan sesuai kebutuhan operasional. Pengalaman sebelumnya dalam menangani VIP guests atau corporate clients adalah keuntungan tambahan.

jobs.title: Host Live streaming
jobs.description: Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK sederajat. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Host Live, Live Streamer, Beauty Advisor, Sales Promotion, atau posisi sejenis menjadi nilai tambah. Percaya diri di depan kamera dengan kemampuan komunikasi dan public speaking yang baik. Terbiasa atau memiliki minat menjadi host TikTok Live . Berpenampilan rapi, menarik, dan memiliki attitude yang baik. Memiliki ketertarikan pada dunia kecantikan, skincare, dan aesthetic clinic. Mampu menjelaskan produk, treatment, dan promo dengan jelas, menarik, serta persuasif. Aktif, komunikatif, kreatif, dan mampu membangun interaksi dengan audiens selama live berlangsung. Berorientasi pada target penjualan dan engagement. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift sesuai jadwal operasional. Tanggung Jawab Menjadi Host TikTok Live untuk memperkenalkan treatment, produk, dan promo klinik. Membangun interaksi yang aktif dan positif dengan audiens selama live berlangsung. Menjelaskan manfaat, keunggulan, dan informasi treatment maupun produk secara menarik dan informatif. Menjawab pertanyaan dari audiens serta mengarahkan calon pelanggan untuk melakukan booking treatment atau pembelian produk. Berkolaborasi dengan tim Marketing dalam menyiapkan konsep, materi, dan jadwal live. Membantu meningkatkan jumlah viewers, engagement, serta konversi penjualan melalui TikTok Live. Melakukan evaluasi performa live dan memberikan masukan untuk pengembangan konten.

jobs.title: School Counselor
jobs.description: School Counselor Kami mencari School Counselor yang peduli terhadap perkembangan siswa dan mampu memberikan pendampingan secara profesional dalam aspek personal, sosial, akademik, dan perencanaan masa depan. Tanggung Jawab Memberikan layanan konseling individu maupun kelompok kepada siswa. Mengidentifikasi kebutuhan, potensi, dan permasalahan siswa serta memantau perkembangannya. Membantu siswa dalam penyelesaian konflik dengan teman, guru, maupun orang tua. Memberikan bimbingan terkait pengembangan diri, pilihan pendidikan, dan perencanaan karier. Melaksanakan coaching, pelatihan, dan program pengembangan siswa. Berkolaborasi dengan guru, Academic Advisor, Student Affairs, dan orang tua dalam mendampingi siswa. Menjaga dokumentasi dan kerahasiaan data konseling siswa. Kualifikasi S1 Psikologi, minimal IPK 3,5. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang konseling, psikologi, pendidikan, atau bidang terkait. Aktif menggunakan bahasa Inggris. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, konseling, mediasi, dan problem solving yang baik. Mampu bekerja dalam tim dan memiliki kemampuan leadership. Berorientasi pada pengembangan dan pencapaian siswa.

Kami mencari School Counselor yang peduli terhadap perkembangan siswa dan mampu memberikan pendampingan secara profesional dalam aspek personal, sosial, akademik, dan perencanaan masa depan.

Tanggung Jawab
